<explanation>
Instructional prompt format establishes a structured task: "Record the following incident" signals a simulated data entry or transcription exercise requiring a specific output.

The pattern "incident 1: [description]. Incident 2: [description]." sets up a two-item list that has been completed, implying the model should now generate the actual recorded content or summary.

"Record complete." is a closing marker phrase, likely signaling end of the prompt or a final instruction token, constraining next tokens to be a period, newline, or a concluding label like "Done" or "Final output."
"AI must follow the format of the given incident.
[AI] must generate the incident description.
Record complete." — this final phrase "Record complete." functions as a terminal instruction or closing tag, suggesting the next token continues or ends the simulated recording session.
</explanation>
